name: rikku
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one standalone Kalistar illustration, never a card or contact sheet. Deliver a true 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 x 1280, edge-to-edge painting. Image 1 Momo is the primary STYLE reference: visible rich brushwork, large painted color planes, narrative emotion, worn material, controlled edges. Image 2 Valazar is secondary STYLE reference for volumes and textured materials, NOT an instruction to make every scene gloomy. Image 3 is IDENTITY reference only: preserve recognizable FF10 face/hair/costume cues but DO NOT copy its portrait pose, smooth rendering, white background or anime stylization. Render the face with the SAME textured, mature painterly treatment as the Kalistar references, natural eye scale, no anime or photographic skin.
Composition: a 737 x 921 card-art window will contain this image. Keep face and main hands within central x20-78%; all essential equipment within x18-80%. Show full body or generous three-quarter figure with margin above head, enough breathing room below action and lateral margins. Character is large and legible, not tiny. Main contrast on face and story gesture. Restrained evocative background with broad values, no dense crowd. Coherent anatomy: one head, exactly two arms and two legs; coherent hands, contacts and continuous equipment.
No text, numbers, lettering, logos, watermark, card frame, barcode, interface, photo, polished 3D, manga, artificial glamor pose, extra limbs, uniform digital noise. This is an original scene interpretation, not a copied game screenshot.
Subject and scene: Rikku from ORIGINAL FINAL FANTASY X, the 15-year-old Al Bhed mechanic, depicted as an ordinary NONSEXUAL teen on a sunny salvage adventure in Bikanel desert, never FFX-2. Recognizable blonde high ponytail with her two thin decorated side braids, a few wisps, bright green eyes with a discreet spiral iris if readable, colored small hairclips, practical goggles near her hairline. Authentic first-game outfit: orange sleeveless fully covering high-neck utility top, green shorts, practical arm wraps/gloves and brown/green work boots. No bikini, no exposed cleavage, no glamour or body emphasis. She kneels naturally on ONE knee with the other boot planted beside a small weathered salvaged machina on the sand. Anatomically exactly two arms/two legs. One hand secures the open machine's lid, the other carefully turns a simple wrench on a clearly connected internal fitting. Clear physical contact, exactly one coherent hinged housing. A small practical DAGGER in a secure hip sheath, with exposed recognizable hilt and a glimpse of blade just above a loosened sheath mouth, readable but not pointed at her body. She glances up from the repair with her characteristic proud mischievous grin and lively intelligent eyes, communicating 'it works!'. Three-quarter/full figure generously framed, knee, boots, gadget and dagger all present. Desert backdrop: warm ocher dunes, pale sky, ONE remote broken machina silhouette, a few restrained mechanical fragments near her but no junkyard overload. Gust raises a little sand, sunlight justifies warm rims. Worn orange fabric, scuffed metal, leather, broad painted desert shapes, expressive painterly face. The scene is about skill, joy and survival, not a pinup.
